# Codefolio

> Executable JavaScript notebooks on a canvas. Notes, code, and results in one continuous document.

A browser-only app where each "page" is a notebook of Markdown cells interleaved with runnable JavaScript cells. Notebooks live on a freeform canvas — drag them around, attach notes, build up a desk of work. The kernel evaluates cells top-to-bottom, persists variables between cells, supports `@name` references, and renders rich return values (HTML, tables, charts, three.js scenes) inline.

There is no server, no auth, no database. Persistence is `localStorage` via a Zustand store.

## What you can do with Codefolio

- **Write & run code in the browser** — Shift+Enter runs a cell; Cmd/Ctrl+Enter inserts a new one.
- **Carry state between cells** — top-level `const`/`let`/`var` declarations persist; reference earlier cells with `@name`.
- **Render rich outputs** — return HTML, a `table(...)`, or a chart from a cell and it paints inline beneath the source.
- **Use bundled libraries** without an import map — `react`, `three`, `@react-three/fiber`, `recharts`, `d3`, `mathjs`, `katex`, `marked`, `lodash-es`, `date-fns`, `papaparse`, `zod`, `lucide-react`.
- **Import source files** (`.js`/`.ts`/`.tsx`/`.mjs`/`.cjs`/`.jsx`) as notebooks; the compiler traces `import` / `require` paths through the reachable graph and runs the bundle in a sandboxed frame.
- **Export a project** as a reproducible ZIP with Vite config, source bundle, walkthrough, and smoke test.

## Repo layout

```
src/
  routes/                  TanStack Start routes. __root.tsx mounts <FolioCanvas/>.
  components/
    canvas/                React Flow canvas, notebook nodes, project preview.
    folio/                 Welcome, appearance panel, toaster, save status.
    notebook/              Cell renderers (code, markdown, image, video, artifact).
    ui/                    Radix + Tailwind primitives.
  lib/
    artifacts/             Source-graph compiler, catalog, project export, assistant.
    notebook/              Notebook runtime — store, kernel, sandbox, helpers, themes.
    error-component.tsx    Root error boundary.
scripts/
  build-artifacts.mjs      Builds public/folio-runtime/ — the kernel + library bundles.
public/
  folio-runtime/           Built bundles (regenerated on dev/build).
  favicon.svg
```

Key files:

- [`README.md`](./README.md) — user-facing overview, scripts, conventions.
- [`AGENTS.md`](./AGENTS.md) — contributor / coding-agent notes.
- [`SOURCE_NOTEBOOKS.md`](./SOURCE_NOTEBOOKS.md) — source-import compiler, project export, AI assistance.

## Kernel contract

A cell runs in an iframe (`src/lib/notebook/sandbox-kernel.ts`). The host injects:

- `chart(data, options?)` — declarative chart (recharts-based).
- `sketch(width, height, fn)` — `<canvas>` 2D drawing surface.
- `html` (tagged template) — return raw HTML; sanitized via DOMPurify.
- `md` (tagged template) — return Markdown; rendered with `marked`.
- `table(data)` — return tabular data; rendered as a grid.
- Any catalogued npm module (see below).

Cell output is captured via the trailing expression's `Display`:

```ts
type Display =
  | { kind: "text"; text: string }
  | { kind: "html"; html: string }
  | { kind: "image"; src: string; alt?: string }
  | { kind: "table"; columns: string[]; rows: string[][] }
  | { kind: "json"; json: string }
  | { kind: "error"; message: string; stack?: string };
```

`console.log` / `info` / `warn` / `error` are captured into a `LogLine[]` stream on the cell output.

## Persistence model

`useFolioStore` (Zustand + `persist` middleware) writes the canvas (`nodes`, `edges`) and per-workspace appearance to `localStorage` under the desk key. Workspaces are namespaced so multiple canvases coexist. Edits debounce, then flush on a maximum delay. Conflicts between tabs detect via a `_migrations`-style version counter; the loser sees a "your edits are behind" notice.

The runtime helpers (`chart`, `sketch`, `md`, `html`, `table`) are exposed via `globalThis.__folioLibraries` populated by the per-group IIFE bundles in `public/folio-runtime/` (`core`, `icons`, `three`, `fiber`, `charts`, `data`, `math`, `text`).

## Bundled libraries

| Module                       | Group   | What it does                            |
| ---------------------------- | ------- | --------------------------------------- |
| `react`, `react-dom`         | core    | Components, hooks, JSX runtime          |
| `lucide-react`               | icons   | Interface icons                         |
| `three`, `three/addons/*`    | three   | Three.js scenes, OrbitControls, GLTFLoader |
| `@react-three/fiber`, `/drei`| fiber   | Declarative Three.js with React         |
| `recharts`                   | charts  | Responsive React charts                 |
| `d3`, `lodash-es`, `date-fns`, `papaparse`, `zod` | data | Visualization, parsing, validation |
| `mathjs`                     | math    | Expressions and arithmetic              |
| `marked`, `katex`            | text    | Markdown rendering, math typesetting    |

Add a library by appending to `src/lib/artifacts/catalog.json` with one of these group tags, then `npm run artifacts:build`.

## Quick start

```bash
npm install
npm run dev          # http://localhost:5173
npm run typecheck    # tsc --noEmit
npm test             # node --test src/lib/**/*.test.ts
npm run build        # production bundle to dist/
npm run lint
```

`predev` and `prebuild` automatically run `artifacts:build`, which produces `public/folio-runtime/` — the kernel and per-library bundles the cells run inside.

## Conventions

- Strict TypeScript. `npm run typecheck` must pass.
- Tailwind v4 entry: `src/styles.css` (`@import "tailwindcss";`).
- Zustand for cross-cutting notebook state.
- Runtime helpers that a cell can call live in `src/lib/notebook/inspect.ts`; new helpers get a test next door.
- No server-only code in client bundles.
- Don't commit `node_modules/`, `dist/`, or anything under `public/folio-runtime/`.
